# Azure Virtual Desktop Insights

Monitoring dashboard for the AVD environment (host pool, workspace, and session hosts) backed by the shared Log Analytics workspace. Data sources: AVD diagnostic categories (Connections, Errors, Checkpoints, Agent Health, Management Activities, Feed) and Azure Monitor Agent (Windows Event Logs, performance counters) from the session hosts.

> If a tile below returns no data, confirm the host pool/workspace diagnostic settings and the session host Data Collection Rule association are active, and that at least one connection/event has occurred since deployment.

content.query:
WVDConnections
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Connections = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), State
| render timechart
content.title: Connections over time (by state)

content.query:
WVDConnections
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Connections = count() by SessionHostName
| sort by Connections desc
| take 25
content.title: Connections by session host

content.query:
WVDConnections
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Sessions = dcount(CorrelationId) by UserName
| sort by Sessions desc
| take 25
content.title: Sessions by user

content.query:
WVDErrors
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize ErrorCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), CodeSymbolic
| render timechart
content.title: Errors over time

content.query:
WVDErrors
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by CodeSymbolic, ServiceError
| sort by Count desc
| take 25
content.title: Top error codes

content.query:
WVDCheckpoints
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by Name
| sort by Count desc
content.title: Connection checkpoints reached (session lifecycle funnel)

content.query:
WVDAgentHealthStatus
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SessionHostName
| project SessionHostName, TimeGenerated, Status, LastHeartBeat
| sort by SessionHostName asc
content.title: Session host agent health (latest status)

content.query:
WVDManagementActivities
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by OperationName, ActivityType
| sort by Count desc
| take 25
content.title: Management activities (host pool / workspace changes)

content.query:
WVDFeeds
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), State
| render timechart
content.title: Workspace feed subscriptions

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total"
| summarize AvgCPU = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Computer
| render timechart
content.title: Average CPU utilization by session host

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where CounterName == "Available MBytes"
| summarize AvgAvailableMB = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Computer
| render timechart
content.title: Available memory (MB) by session host

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where CounterName == "Max Input Delay"
| summarize MaxInputDelayMs = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Computer
| render timechart
content.title: User input delay (RDP responsiveness)

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventLevelName in ("Error", "Warning")
| summarize Count = count() by Computer, EventLevelName, Source
| sort by Count desc
| take 25
content.title: Session host Windows Event Log errors/warnings
